text: ここの　リーダー　キョウは　イガ　ニンジャの　しそんだ！
note: Iga, in today's Mie Prefecture, is the home of one of Japan's two most famous ninja traditions, the other being Kōga. The English game dropped the reference and says only "a long line of ninjas".
claim: Iga, in present-day Mie Prefecture, was home to the Iga-ryū school of ninja, one of the two most famous ninja traditions alongside Kōga.

check.quote: Iga-ryū (伊賀流; 'the Iga School') is an umbrella term for ninjutsu traditions that come from the Iga region ... It became one of the two most well-known ninja traditions in Japan, alongside the Kōga-ryū school.
